evidence.title: Payment evidence queue
evidence.ownRecord: You recorded this; another admin must verify it.
evidence.description: Client payments, refunds and remittances recorded by organizations. A second person must verify each one.
evidence.emptyHint: New evidence shows up here as soon as it's recorded.

disputes.title: Disputes
disputes.description: Disagreements about a placement or its payment. Resolving one returns the placement to its prior status.
disputes.emptyHint: Organizations open disputes from a placement's page.

rules.title: Commission rules
rules.description: The default split for new collaboration agreements. Each change publishes a new version.
rules.snapshotNote: Accepted referrals keep the split that was in force when they were accepted.

orgs.title: Organizations
orgs.name: Name
orgs.description: Every workspace on the platform: members, region and access status.

suspension.reinstateDescription: Members regain access. Matching resumes on the next change.
suspension.suspendDescription: Members immediately lose access. Its jobs and candidates stop matching; existing referrals and finance records are preserved and remain visible to partners; partners can't submit to its jobs.

dispute.resolveDescription: The placement returns to its prior status. Record any corrections as compensating evidence.
dispute.rejectDescription: The placement returns to its prior status.

messages.rulePublished: New rule version published. Existing agreements keep their frozen snapshot.

wallets.title: Wallets
wallets.description: Balances held for organizations, ledger health and outgoing-movement controls.

kpi.revenueHint: Fees recognised in the wallet ledger

health.title: Reconciliation
health.ok: Every cached balance matches its entries and the book sums to zero.
health.bad: The ledger is inconsistent. Pause outgoing movements and investigate before anything else.
health.book: The book does not sum to zero (off by {computed} minor units).
health.unavailable: The reconciliation check is not available on this database yet (migration pending).
health.note: This compares the ledger with itself. Comparing it with the payment provider's balance comes with the provider integration.

transfers.title: Recruiter-to-recruiter transfers
transfers.on: Enabled: organization admins can send available funds to partner organizations.
transfers.off: Disabled: no organization can send funds to another.
transfers.enableDescription: Organization admins will be able to move available funds to partner organizations immediately. Do this only once limits, MFA and the legal review are in place.
transfers.disableDescription: New transfers are refused for every organization. Balances are not affected.

freeze.freezeDescription: The organization can no longer send transfers or withdraw. It can still receive funds, and its members will see that outgoing movements are paused.
freeze.unfreezeDescription: The organization can move its available funds again.

cashouts.title: Withdrawals
cashouts.on: Enabled: organization admins with a verified payout account can withdraw available funds.
cashouts.enableDescription: Organization admins will be able to send available funds to their bank through the payment provider. Do this only once the provider is connected and tested.
cashouts.disableDescription: New withdrawals are refused for every organization. Requests already in progress still complete.

provider.missing: Payment provider not configured: set STRIPE_SECRET_KEY and STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Until then nobody can pay or withdraw through the platform.

attention.title: Needs attention
attention.chargeReason: Reason: {reason}. Resolve it with the payment provider (refund or correct), then record the correction.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Platform health at a glance. Admins never see candidate records, only aggregates.
overview.privacyNote: Counts only. Candidate details stay with their organization.

users.title: Users
users.description: Everyone with an account, the organizations they belong to and their role in each.
users.name: Name

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Every sensitive action across the platform, newest first.
audit.search: Filter by action, e.g. referral. or organization.suspended
